provenance.note: bug 2 was missing from the first version; a smoke-run review on 2026-11-09 found it, then the harness reproduced it

bugs.trigger: the I2C read fails (bus error or NACK) after any earlier reading, or at start
bugs.root_cause: temp_update() ignores the SENSOR_ERR return of sensor_read_raw(), so the old raw value (or 0 at start) is kept and ctrl_step() cannot tell the sensor failed
bugs.impact: with the sensor unreadable the heater keeps following a stale temperature and can stay on, against T07 4.1#2 (heater off within one step)

bugs.trigger: a reading of raw 929 (58.0625 °C) with the 60 °C target
bugs.root_cause: temp_celsius_x10() truncates raw * 10 / 16 toward zero, so ctrl_step()'s t <= target_x10 - 20 also holds for readings up to 0.0625 °C above 58 °C
bugs.impact: the heater turns on at 1.9375 °C below the target, against T07 4.1#1 (2 °C or more below)
